---
title: "Reconstruct a multi-registration protocol"
output: html_document
---

One registration can contribute several canonical study days. An explicit
ordered manifest fixes the cohort protocol order and retains the canonical
position of a registration that is absent for one participant.

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(carwatch)

control_ids <- c("control-1", "control-2", "control-3", "control-4")
challenge_ids <- c("challenge-1", "challenge-2", "challenge-3", "challenge-4")

study_config <- list(
  saliva_distances = c(0, 30, 15, 15),
  registrations = list(
    list(
      study_name = "Control",
      study_days = 2,
      registration_date = "2026-03-01",
      saliva_ids = control_ids,
      condition = "control"
    ),
    list(
      study_name = "Challenge",
      study_days = 2,
      registration_date = "2026-03-08",
      saliva_ids = challenge_ids,
      condition = "challenge"
    )
  )
)

study_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "carwatch-gallery-multi-registration")
generate_synthetic_study_data(
  study_dir,
  study_config = study_config,
  n_participants = 3,
  non_compliant_sample_ratio = 0.10,
  missing_awakening_time_ratio = 0,
  missing_sampling_time_ratio = 0,
  random_state = 42,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  validate = FALSE
)
```

```{r manifest}
folders <- list.dirs(file.path(study_dir, "logs"), recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
participant_dirs <- stats::setNames(folders, basename(folders))
raw_logs <- read_raw_logs_from_participant_dirs(participant_dirs)

protocol_manifest <- list(
  list(
    study_name = "Control",
    study_days = 2,
    saliva_ids = control_ids,
    saliva_times = c(0, 30, 15, 15),
    saliva_absolute_times = character()
  ),
  list(
    study_name = "Challenge",
    study_days = 2,
    saliva_ids = challenge_ids,
    saliva_times = c(0, 30, 15, 15),
    saliva_absolute_times = character()
  )
)

study_results <- convert_raw_logs(
  raw_logs,
  protocol_manifest = protocol_manifest,
  errors = "raise"
)

summarize_protocol(raw_logs, protocol_manifest = protocol_manifest)
as_study_days(study_results)
```
